 See more of our coverage in your search results.

 Not all of Hailey Bieber’s go-to lip products come from Rhode.
 The star has been using her makeup artist Mary Phillips’ M.ph Top Coat Lip Gloss on repeat lately — and she’s not the only one. When Oprah Winfrey dropped her 2026 Favorite Things on Thursday, we spotted the same product in a prominent place on the list.
 “The colors in these glosses are gorgeous, and I love that you can see them in their containers,” the media mogul wrote on Oprah Daily . 
 M.ph by Mary Phillips Top Coat Lip Gloss 
 M.Ph Beauty 
 M.PH BEAUTY $26.00 
 SEPHORA $26.00 
 She added that Phillips — who also works with Kendall Jenner — recommends using either a single swipe for shine or layering any of the eight shades “to find a lovely custom hue.”
 With colors ranging from mauve to nude, Top Coat delivers balm-like nourishment and a non-sticky feel.
 Phillips used it on Bieber during her trip to Paris this October, writing in her Substack newsletter, “Hail Mary,” that the My Girl shade “keeps her lips hydrated and adds a touch of pink, a dash of shimmer and a lot of shine.”

 In addition to wearing it to the Academy Museum Gala last month, the Rhode founder’s also used it in her own social media posts, pairing it with the M.ph Overliner Lip Pencil in a TikTok this fall.
 Bieber swiped some on in a TikTok video this fall. Hailey Bieber/TikTok 
 Plenty of shoppers love the formula, too, with reviewers calling it everything from “gorgeous” to “my favorite lip gloss.”
 “I have chronically dry lips so I can’t really use lip glosses or lipsticks,” one shopper wrote. “This product has changed that drastically! It is SO hydrating. I can just put one or two coats and my lips stay hydrated for hours.”
 While Phillips’ hacks and products are hits with young stars, Oprah’s proof they’re not all Gen Z hype.
